name: Corpus Callosum Dysgenesis-Hypopituitarism Syndrome

criteria.description: Imaging evidence of corpus callosum agenesis or dysgenesis
Clinical and biochemical evidence of hypopituitarism (deficiency of one or more pituitary hormones)
Presence of developmental delay or intellectual disability

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of corpus callosum dysgenesis on imaging plus clinical and biochemical evidence of hypopituitarism
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is clinical supported by neuroimaging and endocrine evaluation; genetic testing may assist but is not definitive.

pathognomonic.notes: Confirmed by MRI or CT imaging
searchTerms: lack of brain connection between hemispheres

pathognomonic.notes: Including growth hormone deficiency and secondary adrenal insufficiency

searchTerms: low blood sugar in newborn from pituitary failure
neonatal hypoglycemia due to hormone lack
newborn low sugar caused by pituitary issues

common.symptomName: Short stature due to growth hormone deficiency
searchTerms: short height from growth hormone lack
delayed growth due to hormone deficiency
small stature from low growth hormone

occasional.notes: May be secondary to brain malformations

occasional.symptomName: Delayed puberty due to gonadotropin deficiency
searchTerms: late puberty from low sex hormones
slow onset of puberty due to hormone deficiency

rare.notes: Mild facial anomalies may be present

laboratory: Low serum levels of pituitary hormones (GH, ACTH, TSH, LH, FSH)
Low cortisol and thyroid hormone levels
imaging: MRI showing agenesis or hypoplasia of corpus callosum
Pituitary hypoplasia or ectopic posterior pituitary on MRI
genetic: No consistent genetic mutation identified; some cases show mutations in genes involved in brain and pituitary development (e.g., HESX1, LHX4)
other: Endocrine stimulation tests confirming pituitary hormone deficiencies

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of optic nerve hypoplasia and midline brain abnormalities
Often includes pituitary hormone deficiencies but with characteristic septum pellucidum absence
Facial anomalies such as cyclopia or cleft lip/palate
Different pattern of brain abnormalities on imaging

redFlags: Neonatal hypoglycemia refractory to standard treatment
Failure to thrive with progressive growth failure
Severe developmental delay with neurological abnormalities
